title: Wall Preparation for Interior Casing in Lead-Safe Jobs — Installation Jobs
content:
**Wall preparation for casing in lead-safe jobs — Installation Jobs**

Removing old painted casing in a lead-safe job needs wall preparation around each opening. When new interior casing is priced on an **Installation Jobs** record, a wall-preparation adder per casing opening follows the job charges recorded on the job:

| Job's charges | Wall-preparation adder |
|---|---|
| carry a lead-safe fee and a rot repair charge | $18.00 per casing opening |
| carry a lead-safe fee and no rot repair charge | $12.00 per casing opening |
| carry no lead-safe fee | none |

A lead-safe fee and a rot repair charge are read as job charges of those kinds recorded on the job.

## Truth table

| Lead-safe fee on the job | Rot repair charge on the job | Adder per casing opening |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | $18.00 |
| yes | no | $12.00 |
| no | yes | none |
| no | no | none |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A job with 7 casing openings whose charges carry a lead-safe fee and one rot repair charge: 7 multiplied by 18.00, that is 126.00, joins the casing price.
